digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow and plan review modules
propositions: Nine modules are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC cap, with gate_dispatch.py at 799 LOC having only 1 line of headroom, blocking story 343b's gap-5 parameter threading

Gate_dispatch.py must be split along the existing plan-review recovery call-graph seam (51 lines of constants, helper functions, and recovery handlers) into a new plan_review_recovery.py module of ~300 LOC

Orchestrator.py must be split along the context-assembly call-graph seam (lines 88-244) into a new context_assembly.py module of ~157 LOC to create 154 lines of headroom for 343b's finalize_verdict parameter
After split completion, gate_dispatch.py must land at 527 LOC (271 lines of headroom) and orchestrator.py at 646 LOC (154 lines of headroom), both well under 700 LOC
Both extracted modules must be re-imported into their origin files to maintain existing test monkeypatch seams and external reference style, achieving zero test edits
The code-review gate cluster in gate_dispatch.py must NOT be extracted in this split because its monkeypatch-by-string references (14 sites) would silently stop taking effect if the code moved
